lcc_original: 塞特也生了一個兒子，他就給兒子起名叫以挪士【5】：【6】這人是最先【6】呼求永恆主之名的。
notes: UNV {<WH01931>} is implicit (no explicit Chinese pronoun), but LCC provides explicit 他; dropped braces and attached as 他<WH01931> per Rule 3.

WAH0227 (אָז 'then') and WH02490+WTH8717 (הוּחַל Hophal 'it was begun') are both attached to 最先, because LCC renders the Hebrew Hophal passive + temporal adverb as 是最先 ('was the first to'), compressing both ideas into one adjectival phrase.
LCC introduces 這人是 as an explicit grammatical subject for the Hophal passive—no SN attaches here, as the Hebrew has no explicit nominal subject at this point.
之名 receives WAH09002+WH08034 (בְּשֵׁם 'in/with the name') intact; UNV's 的名 maps cleanly to LCC's 之名 (both are genitive constructions).
The 【5】【6】 footnote markers are preserved in their original positions without modification.
